name: less-tokens
summary: Cut LLM prompt token costs by 30-40% with deterministic, training-free lexical compression for OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini and any LLM API. Zone-aware compression protects JSON schemas and output formats; PDFs and Word files reduce to Markdown. Includes a 6-metric quality evaluator. The optional agent extra adds a local-first chat app: a local Ollama model answers what it can, a router escalates the rest to the cheapest frontier model, with automatic RAG, rolling chat summaries and a token ledger in SQLite.
